sourceSemantics: Static page text nodes and aria/title/meta descriptions only. Not game events, Go engine, scoring, provider or dynamic status strings.

segments.VT-COS｜悟之一手｜棋盤練習: A Move of Insight | Play Go
segments.CHOOSE THE APERTURE · 本機練習: YOUR BOARD · PRACTICE ON THIS DEVICE
segments.棋盤尺寸不代表已進入局面應用: Board size is a choice, not a skill level
segments.5×5、7×7、9×9 與 19×19 是不同尺度的練習入口，不是能力階梯。: Choose 5×5, 7×7, 9×9, or 19×19 for the game you want to play. A larger board doesn't mean you've advanced a level.
segments.5×5／7×7 適合練規則與局部判斷，9×9 是完整小棋盤，19×19 是完整棋: Use 5×5 or 7×7 to explore rules and small local fights. On 9×9 you can finish a short game; 19×19 gives you the full board. You can save a game to study later, but its result alone does not measure your Go ability.
segments.適合直接開始練習: Ready to play with no extra setup
segments.第一次使用不需要安裝其他程式，也不需要申請 API 金鑰；選「練習電腦」即可開始: You can start immediately with the built-in practice computer. No installation or API key is needed.
segments.進階：更換電腦引擎: Advanced: choose a different Go engine
segments.這裡是進階設定，不影響一般初學練習。無法連線時會停止電腦回合，不會偷偷改用另一個: These settings are optional. If the selected engine cannot connect, the computer's turn stops. The site will not quietly switch to another engine.
segments.它是獨立的圍棋 AI 引擎，不是使用本頁的必要條件。這個網站本身不能直接執行 K: KataGo is a separate Go AI engine; you do not need it for regular practice. This web page cannot run KataGo itself. Local KataGo mode connects only to a connector already running on your device. Other visitors cannot use that mode unless they install and start their own connector.
segments.遠端對弈 API（跨裝置／網站訪客）: Remote Go API (other devices and visitors)
segments.如果要讓不同裝置或網站訪客共用 KataGo，需要另外架設可連線的 HTTPS: To share a KataGo service between devices or with site visitors, you must set up a reachable HTTPS API and enter its endpoint here. This project
segments.沒有提供共用的 KataGo 服務: does not provide a shared KataGo service
segments.。本頁只保存連線位址，不會要求或保存 API 金鑰；如果服務需要密鑰，應由你自己: . This page stores only the endpoint, not an API key. If your service requires a secret, keep it on a server or Cloudflare Worker you control.
segments.黑棋先下。滑鼠、觸控或鍵盤方向鍵移動，Enter／空白鍵落子。: Black plays first. Select a point with a mouse, touch, or the arrow keys; press Enter or Space to place a stone.
segments.這一回合不落子，把行棋權交給對方；雙方連續各停一手後，本頁進入終局確認。: You give up your turn without placing a stone. After both players pass consecutively, this page enters end-of-game confirmation.
segments.終局時雙方同意已無法逃脫、應從盤上移除的棋。系統不自動判死活，有爭議就繼續下。: At the end of a game, the players agree which stones cannot survive and should be removed. This page does not decide life and death automatically. If you disagree, resume play.
segments.本頁把盤上活棋與其圍住的空點一起計入面積，再加上貼目比較結果。: This page counts living stones and the empty points they surround as area, then applies komi when comparing scores.
segments.為補償白棋後下，在最後計分時加給白棋的點數；9×9 本頁目前使用 7.5。: Points added to White's score to compensate for playing second. This page currently uses 7.5 on 9×9.
segments.剛提子後不能立刻回到上一個棋形；先到別處走一手後，是否能再提要重新依局面判定。: An immediate recapture cannot recreate the preceding board position. After playing elsewhere, whether a recapture is legal depends on the new position.
segments.常見的純文字圍棋棋譜格式，可保存棋盤尺寸、手順、Pass、貼目與結果等資料。: A widely used text format for Go games. It can record board size, move order, passes, komi and results.
segments.確認終局與死子: Confirm the end of the game
segments.點選棋盤上的棋串可標記／取消死子。系統不自動判死活；若雙方有爭議，請繼續下棋。: Select a group to mark or unmark it as dead. The site does not decide this automatically; if the players disagree, continue playing.
segments.這是本局規則與人工終局確認下的結果；不代表學習成效或棋力評定。: This result follows the selected scoring rules and your end-of-game confirmation. It does not establish learning progress or rank.
segments.保存這盤棋: Keep a copy of this game
segments.每個棋盤尺寸各自保存續局。匯入時必須與目前尺寸相同；未結束棋局也可匯出。: Each board size has its own resumable game. Imported SGF files must match the selected size. You may export a game before it ends.
segments.棋盤練習目前支援一般劫爭規則，終局死子由使用者自行確認。: Board practice supports the currently implemented ko rule. Players must agree which stones are dead at the end.
segments.VT-COS｜悟之一手的 5×5、7×7、9×9 與 19×19 本機棋盤練習。: Play Go on 5×5, 7×7, 9×9 or 19×19 boards in your browser.
segments.回到 VT-COS｜悟之一手首頁: Return to the A Move of Insight home page
